decisions.reason: The fabrication sequence for POS 1, POS 2, and POS 3 does not alter the bushing or piston-rod arrangement; that arrangement is separately addressed by other clauses in the same message and already has its own Event.
The fabrication sequence does not change drawing layout or presentation conventions; drawing numbering is separately addressed and already represented by a same-message Event.
The fabrication sequence changes assembly manufacturing requirements but does not change the obligation to deliver a 3D model or its required file formats.
The source fabrication-sequence decision does not itself establish or change a dimension-annotation requirement.
The manufacturing drawing deliverable remains required unchanged; the fabrication sequence is an underlying design requirement and does not independently alter the drawing-set delivery obligation.
